summary: IMPLEMENTATION PLAN for Method A (Half-1 lossless): safely enable VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT with the TREE_ATTN forked-FA2 backend (allowlist guard at batch_invariant.py:1012) — now JUSTIFIED by the num_splits proof — to engage fp8-GEMM batch-invariance and run the decisive B=4 carrier test (fp8-GEMM vs diffuse wiring). CPU plan only, no GPU.

synthesis.what_bi_flips: VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT (live /tmp/vllm_live_019, verified on disk) does FOUR classes of things, and exactly ONE of them reads the backend name. (1) The allowlist guard itself — override_envs_for_invariance() at batch_invariant.py:990-1017 (decode_invariant_backends=[FLASH_ATTN,TRITON_ATTN] :993-996; supported adds FLASH_ATTN_MLA/TRITON_MLA; raise :1008-1017), called once per GPU worker from init_batch_invariance (:1044-1055, gated on envs.VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT) <- gpu_worker.py init_worker_distributed_environment :1012-1024 inside Worker.init_device, BEFORE model load. It checks only the configured backend ENUM NAME (never per-layer hybrid backends), which is why the GDN-hybrid with TREE_ATTN serving only the 16 full-attn layers is rejected wholesale (reproduced: FR13_B4_BATCH_INVARIANT_GATE_BLOCKED.md, e9f9267c). The only other name-keyed BI code is the prefix-caching disable for FLASHINFER/TRITON_MLA — does not fire for TREE_ATTN. (2) Global numerics flips (backend-agnostic, engage identically under any name once the guard passes): aten softmax/_softmax/_log_softmax/mean.dim/bmm overrides + torch.bmm monkeypatch (:959-969), fp16/bf16 reduced-precision reductions OFF (:971-986), preferred cublaslt (:987), TF32->ieee (:1052-1055), CUBLAS workspace pinning, NCCL/symm-mem/custom-allreduce/cascade/AOT-compile disables (no-ops at TP=1 except cascade/AOT), RMSNorm -> batch-invariant Triton, autotune-config pinning (MoE/LoRA, dormant for this dense no-LoRA model), UnquantizedLinearMethod -> Triton BI GEMM (linear.py:226-228, covers bf16 lm_head/logits — the L0c drift seam). GB10 caveat: sm_121=family 120 takes the ELSE branch at :938-957, so the aten mm/addmm/matmul/linear Triton overrides do NOT install; instead CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=':16:8' + CUBLASLT_WORKSPACE_SIZE=1 (split-k suppression). (3) Attention flips: ALL implemented inside each backend's own file (FLASH_ATTN num_splits=1 + FA2 pin, TRITON_ATTN 2D-kernel forcing, flashinfer/MLA/flex) — they simply never execute under TREE_ATTN, and nothing misfires. (4) fp8 GEMMs — THE KEY FINDING: for qwen3.6-27b-fp8 (block-quant [128,128]) the Fp8LinearMethod BI branch (fp8.py:449-455) routes to the SAME W8A8BlockFp8LinearOp as non-BI, dispatching on GB10 to cutlass_scaled_mm regardless (deepgemm/flashinfer unsupported, cuda.py:515-517). BI does NOT swap the fp8 kernel; FR12 direct kernel probes (FR12_PARITY_RESULTS.md:808-834) showed the cutlass blockscale GEMM + per-token-group act quant are INHERENTLY batch-invariant. So 'engage fp8-GEMM BI under TREE_ATTN' really means: the fp8 GEMMs behave byte-identically BI-on/off (already invariant by construction), and what BI newly pins is the SURROUNDING numerics — bf16/unquantized linears (lm_head), softmax, bmm, RMSNorm, cuBLAS split-k/workspace, reduced-precision reductions, TF32 — all backend-agnostic, all engaging cleanly under a TREE_ATTN-named backend. TREE_ATTN itself already runs in the BI kernel configuration: tree_attn.py calls the same unified_attention as allowlisted TRITON_ATTN and never passes 3D softmax-segment buffers, so the 2D (batch-invariant) kernel is selected always (triton_unified_attention.py:979-987). Honest reframe for the experiment: CASE 1 confirms a 'BI-coverable numerics' carrier (most plausibly bf16 lm_head GEMM / softmax / RMSNorm / cuBLAS split-k), not literally the fp8 cutlass kernels. Minor misfire surface: the global torch.bmm/aten-bmm overrides accept only bf16/fp16/fp32 — any glue code calling bmm on fp8/int tensors would now raise loudly (acceptable, fail-loud). Residual unknowns: ':16:8' split-k suppression on family-120 is upstream's Hopper claim applied by fallthrough; BI under FULL CUDA-graph capture is unverified end-to-end (first boot may need ENFORCE_EAGER=1 fallback for all arms); module-level env snapshots (triton_unified_attention.py:18) require VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT=1 at container launch — our path, fine.
synthesis.enablement_plan: DECISION: allowlist relaxation via the existing boot-time on-disk patcher; rename/registration as FLASH_ATTN REJECTED. Patch point: new _patch_batch_invariant_guard() added to patch_installed_vllm() in /home/mark/shared/lumoFlyWheel/scripts/fr13_patch_fa2_tree_bias.py (:716-727), which already edits dist-packages files and runs before `exec vllm serve` in scripts/fr13_launch_forked_fa2_tree_server.sh (:157-158 -> :168); the worker's lazy import (gpu_worker.py:1022) guarantees the on-disk edit lands before the guard by construction (runtime monkeypatching cannot work — separate processes). EDIT 1 (guard): anchored on the exact decode_invariant_backends block at batch_invariant.py:993-996 (verified verbatim on disk), append behind sentinel env FR13_BI_TREE_ATTN=1, double-gated: it must ALSO see FR13_FA2_TREE_BIAS=1 AND FR13_FA2_PREFILL_NATIVE=1 or raise a loud RuntimeError ('BI justification covers only the forked-FA2 tree decode + native-FA2 prefill paths'); then decode_invariant_backends.append(TREE_ATTN). Appending to decode_invariant_backends (not just supported_backends) suppresses the :1018-1023 prefill-vs-decode warning — honest because deployed prefill AND decode run the same forked FA2 varlen binary, non-split dispatch, equal up to the accepted FR13 single-ULP floor (14/16 calls byte-exact, 2 single-ULP in ~1M). EDIT 2 (close the one real gap): in _patch_tree_attn's tree-bias decode call (patcher :570 block), add `num_splits=1 if envs.VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT else 0` (envs import already injected at :464-470). PER-ATTENTION-PATH JUSTIFICATION (why this is not a blind rename): (i) tree decode (verify + drafter levels>0): the num_splits proof (397319ab, FR13_NUM_SPLITS_NATIVE_FLOOR_BIND.md) — set_params_splitkv is gated by seqlenq_ngroups_swapped which requires max_seqlen_q==1, but tree_len=10>1, so num_splits stays 0 = non-split dispatch, no combine kernel, reduction batch-composition-INDEPENDENT by construction; the in-kernel bias add is an elementwise per-row load from a fixed [10,10] fp32 tensor. GAP closed by EDIT 2: an all-1-token decode segment WOULD enter the split-kv heuristic (batch-variant); the forcing is provably inert for tree shapes. (ii) prefill (incl. drafter root, all-prefill via empty-bias decode_threshold=0): FR13_FA2_PREFILL_NATIVE=1 already emits the byte-identical `num_splits=1 if envs.VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT else 0` expression as native FLASH_ATTN prefill (patcher :537 vs flash_attn.py:774/795), tree_bias_ptr=nullptr early-return — batch-invariant exactly as the allowlisted 'best supported backend'. (iii) everything else: triton unified_attention fallbacks unreachable under the deployed flag combo (and BI-safe anyway — 2D kernel forced); cascade impossible (tree_attn.py:74-76 + global BI disable); encoder impossible (DECODER-only assert); reshape_and_cache_flash is a per-slot scatter, trivially invariant; GDN layers run the separate backend identical to sanctioned FLASH_ATTN+BI runs and are independently proven invariant (beec984a/e4a6a2f2/45519178). WHY RENAME IS REJECTED: registering the fork under the FLASH_ATTN name passes the guard by relabeling, not justification — enum-keyed dispatch at platforms/cuda.py:103/109/347/354 and mm_encoder_attention.py:109/217/439 would silently engage FLASH_ATTN-specific behavior on a non-FLASH backend, the eagle.py:950-951 TreeAttentionMetadataBuilder assert deepens the name/behavior mismatch, and it grants decode-invariant status with zero evidence trail = the banned reward-hack class (feedback_no_reroute_reward_hacking; FR13_COST_GATE_BI_TREE_BACKEND_BLOCKED.md already binds no-rename). STRICT GATES: (1) boot needles extending the launcher's :159-167 check — installed batch_invariant.py contains FR13_BI_TREE_ATTN AND installed tree_attn.py contains the num_splits-if-BI expression, abort otherwise; (2) fail-loud engagement — BI-on boot success itself proves the guard passed (flag violations raise in every worker); log-assert attention_backend: TREE_ATTN + the BI enable line before recording any number; (3) BI-off inertness is structural (the patched lines live inside override_envs_for_invariance, never called when VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT=0; EDIT 2 evaluates to the previous default 0) — verify with one BATCH_INVARIANT=0 boot + the existing no-bias pristine compare; (4) all pristine/parity baselines must be re-captured BI-ON for BI-on comparisons (every existing artifact is BI-OFF). Launch script: add `-e FR13_BI_TREE_ATTN=...` next to :74-75. Bonus BI-orthogonal hardening flagged (separate commit): swapped-mode max_seqlen_q reassignment before set_params_tree_bias would mis-address a non-empty bias on a 1-token decode batch — gate use_tree_bias on decode_meta.max_query_len>1.
synthesis.experiment_protocol: PINNED PROTOCOL (held constant, = the measured-floor protocol): single launcher scripts/fr13_launch_forked_fa2_tree_server.sh for every arm; GPU_UTIL=0.82 explicitly (launcher default 0.88), MAX_NUM_SEQS=4/B=4, FR13_FA2_PREFILL_NATIVE=1, FR10_METRICS=0, FULL CUDA capture (ENFORCE_EAGER unset), temp 0.6/top_p 0.95, BATCH_INVARIANT=1 on all new arms. Probe shapes per boot: P64 (4 SWE prompts x 1 x 64 = 256 positions, the shape the BI-off floor 0.1133 binds to) and P16 (4x4, ~467 positions, matching the BI-off 3-arm gate). ARMS (5 boots, all BI-on): T1 tree TREE_ATTN/tree_mtp seed 1313, P64 TWICE within-boot (T1a/T1b) + P16, tree_path_lcp + sampler-debug logs on; T2 tree identical FRESH boot seed 1313 (cross-boot determinism — the e263a45b-shaped comparison); N1 native FLASH_ATTN/naive_mtp seed 1313, P64 twice + P16; N2 native fresh boot seed 1313 = the BI same-seed native floor (droppable to 4 boots if time-bound); Nn native-noise seed 2313 (REQUIRED: fr13_corruption_gate.py refuses PASS on an empty self-noise mask :384-389, and the BI same-seed mask is expected degenerate). Seeds 1313/2313 match the BI-off references exactly so cross-regime deltas pair. REUSED BI-off arms (no reruns): 194841Z gate (real-loss 0.4751, bag-TV 0.2335 vs budget 0.1099, accept 2.1016 vs 3.6192, root-reject 36.6%), 220457Z tree_repeat (189/256 nondet, rows move), 234548Z floor (0.1133, 139/256); the 220457Z BI-native pair ran at 0.86 not 0.82 — sanity-only. ENGAGEMENT ASSERTS before any metric: container env shows VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT=1+LUMO_BATCH_INVARIANT_VLLM=1; BI init line in docker_full.log; per-arm regime proof (backend line, gpu_util 0.82, enforce_eager=False, 4/4 cuda_graph_proof); tree arms --require-tree-engagement. REDUCTIONS (CPU): corruption gate (T1,N1,Nn) per shape at committed thresholds (BAG_TV_FLOOR=0.0593, ACCEPT_SLACK=0.05, MAX_REAL_LOSS=0.05); determinism compares T1a-T1b, T1-T2, N1a-N1b, N1-N2; cross-regime delta table; depth-0 root-reject rerun on T1. DECISION TREE — CASE 1 (carrier = fp8-GEMM/BI-coverable batch-variance CONFIRMED): gate exit 0 on BOTH shapes + accept/event tree-BI >= native-BI - 0.05 (out of the 2.10 contaminated band into the native band ~3.1-3.2 on P64; the 2.024->3.794 spine-recovered signal is confirmed later in the BI-off deployed SWE-4 e2e, not here) + root-reject 36.6% -> ~0. Chain: bind verify-function-lossless, then the production-implication path. CASE 2 (excess REMAINS = diffuse wiring carrier + the system is NOW DETERMINISTIC — the bonus path): real_loss >= 0.24 OR accept-delta <= -1.0 OR depth-collapse. Chain, in order: (2a) HARD GATE verify determinism FIRST — T1a==T1b==T2 must be EXACT (4/4 records, 256/256 positions, 16/16 P16); if not exact, BI did not pin the tree path — bind 'non-GEMM nondeterminism channel persists', STOP the row chain, localize the channel (N1==N2 but T1!=T2 => tree-specific; both inexact => engagement/scheduler) — never capture into a moving target again; (2b) row discovery in the same deterministic boot: first outside-mask real loss (p,q) from the gate -> rerun with FR10_TREE_DEPTH_POSITION_LOG + tree_path_lcp to map (p,q)->(verify call c, row r) — determinism makes the mapping stable, which is precisely what FAILED at e263a45b (failing row moved between runs); (2c) one eager+BI ladder boot: first re-verify the loss reproduces token-identically under ENFORCE_EAGER=1+BI, then FR10_LAYER_HIDDEN_CAPTURE_ROWS={r+ancestry} + FR13_FINAL_LOGIT_CAPTURE pinned to call c, paired native-BI eager capture; first-diverging layer = the seam; classify WIRING vs KERNEL per standing policy (fix wiring / build our kernel; no reroute/copy). CASE 3 (mixed/partial — including ANY metric disagreement, e.g. token metrics pass but accept stays low): per-metric apportionment GEMM_share_m = clamp01((m_BIoff - m_BIon)/m_BIoff) over {bag-TV excess 0.1202, real_loss 0.4751, accept-delta -1.5175, root-reject 0.366}; bind all four shares, do NOT average if spread > ~0.3 (per-metric carriers can differ); chain = case-2 localization driven by the wiring-dominated metric, GEMM share banked under the case-1 production reasoning. Remainder is only 'real' if 2a-determinism holds AND it exceeds the measured BI floor (N1-vs-N2) — if N1==N2 exactly, every outside-mask tree mismatch is real and deterministic = maximal localization power. CONSTRAINTS: NO speed/TPS numbers from any BI run (fields marked non-citable in the bind); ask before close/pass-fail; commit+push bind (FR13_B4_BI_DECISIVE_CARRIER_BIND.md) + ladder-log entry appended after FR13_LADDER_LOG.md:1319 each step.
synthesis.production_implication: If CASE 1 (fp8-GEMM/BI-coverable variance is the carrier): BI-on is NOT required in production for lossless — the relative within-floor bar STANDS BI-off. Reasoning: lossless has always been defined as within-the-same-regime native floor vs E5 (per-depth-argmax + bag-TV <= floor, NOT byte-exact — reference_lossless_specdecode_gate_methodology + the user's 2026-06-09 FR13 bar), and the BI-off native floor 0.1133 already CONTAINS the same GEMM batch-variance the tree sees: native MTP-5 itself is exposed to it run-to-run. BI-on is the DIAGNOSTIC regime whose job is to pin numerics and prove the verify computes the same function as native; shipping it would fight the actual objective (BI GEMMs are slow; speed is the goal, FR10 lesson). CRITICAL CAVEAT that must be bound with the verdict: CASE 1 does NOT automatically mean BI-off tree passes the BI-off relative bar. The measured BI-off tree excess (bag-TV 0.2335 vs floor 0.113, ~2x) shows the spec-decode feedback loop AMPLIFIES the shared variance through accept-pattern-keyed state reads — the conv prior-window read (fr10_phase4_patch_vllm_tree_gdn.py:~797-818) and the h0 bank-row read (fr10_gdn_tree_kernel.py:261-267, FR13_NONDET_SOURCE_VERDICT.md): native re-derives a fresh trajectory under perturbation while the tree's accepted-count-keyed state reads compound it. So the CASE-1 chained work is: (a) bind 'verify-function lossless under BI; residual = noise amplification, not wrong math'; (b) de-amplify the conv/h0 accept-pattern seams so BI-off tree noise falls within the BI-off native floor; (c) re-run the BI-off 3-arm gate and only then the deployed-regime SWE-4 e2e (lossless within E5 floor + accept/event >= 3.794 spine-recovered + speed measured BI-off per-request). Which framing ultimately ships — (i) BI-off tree within BI-off floor after de-amplification (preferred: keeps speed) vs (ii) a BI-on 'certified deterministic' mode (slower, only if the user wants byte-level reproducibility as a product property) — is a USER decision; ask before any close/pass-fail per standing policy. If CASE 2/3 instead: the production question is moot until the deterministic localization fixes the wiring carrier; the bar remains the BI-off relative bar throughout.
synthesis.cost_and_order: COST: CPU-side prep (this plan): the two patcher edits + sentinel + boot needles + launch-script env line, plus reducer dry-runs against the reused BI-off artifacts (194841Z/220457Z/234548Z) — all doable NOW with zero GPU, committed on the feature branch. GPU: base experiment = 5 boots (T1, T2, N1, N2, Nn; droppable to 4 by cutting N2, at the cost of a weaker within-boot-only BI floor claim — cross-boot preferred because the BI-off floor was cross-boot). Measured BI-off arm wall was ~8.5-9.5 min (194841Z mtimes); BI adds GEMM slowdown to capture+decode, estimate 12-16 min/arm including host-memory recovery + model load + FULL B=4 capture + P64x2+P16 probes => ~60-80 min GPU sequential + ~5 min CPU reductions; budget 2 h with one relaunch margin (first BI+TREE_ATTN+FULL-capture boot is an untested combination — if it fails, fall back to ENFORCE_EAGER=1 for ALL five arms, internally consistent but a different regime, bind it as such). CASE-2 bonus chain adds 2-3 boots (+30-45 min). One container at a time; launcher prelaunch handles host-memory recovery (aborts if MemAvailable<80GiB). ORDERING vs the in-flight accept-only build: codex_fr19's accept-only (HBM tax) work is SEPARABLE — it shares no files with the BI guard patch and answers a different question (cost of acceptance bookkeeping, not the carrier) — but it owns the single GB10 GPU and the codex worker context. Therefore: (1) NOW, in parallel and CPU-only per the parallel-CPU-workflows policy: write + commit the patcher edits, boot needles, the FR13_B4_BI_DECISIVE_CARRIER_BIND.md skeleton, and the arm-runner script with engagement asserts; dry-run the corruption-gate/determinism reducers on existing BI-off run dirs to de-risk the reduction step. (2) AFTER codex_fr19's accept-only run completes and its result is committed+bound (do not preempt; monitor per the codex_fr16-lineage tmux mechanics), take the GPU: one BATCH_INVARIANT=0 inertness boot (pristine compare unchanged), then the 5 BI arms in sequence T1->T2->N1->N2->Nn, then CPU reductions, then the case-keyed chain. (3) Speed numbers: never from BI runs; the deployed-regime BI-off SWE-4 e2e (lossless + superset + per-request TPS vs E5) comes only after the carrier verdict and any chained fix. Commit+push the bind + ladder-log entry at every step on the feature branch; verify the work is in HEAD each monitor tick.

overreaches: SYN states the fp8 cutlass blockscale GEMM is 'INHERENTLY batch-invariant' as settled fact but drops reader A's caveat: FR12's probe evidence cites torch.ops.vllm.padded_cutlass (the is_hopper branch) from the 0.22 source tree, while the live GB10 binding is plain cutlass_scaled_mm (fp8_utils.py:447-475); the exact live-bound op was never re-probed. Mechanism-plausible, but the residual-unknowns list should carry it.

CASE-2a bind language 'non-GEMM nondeterminism channel persists' mislabels the failure mode: BI verifiably does NOT pin the fp8 cutlass GEMMs on GB10 (fp8.py:449-455 routes to the same op BI-off), so a persisting nondeterminism channel could be the fp8 GEMM itself if the FR12 inherent-invariance claim fails for the live op. Bind as 'non-BI-covered channel persists' and include the fp8 cutlass GEMM in the candidate list.

The per-path enumeration omits the swap-dispatch channel: whether seqlenq_ngroups_swapped fires for a 1-token decode row depends on co-resident rows' max_seqlen_q (flash_api.cpp:632), and EDIT 2 pins num_splits but not the swapped-vs-nonswapped kernel-config choice. It is parity (identical gate in allowlisted FLASH_ATTN) and FULL capture bakes shapes, so not a hack — but it should be stated explicitly rather than left implicit.

The swapped-mode tree-bias mis-addressing hardening (gate use_tree_bias on decode_meta.max_query_len>1) is deferred to a 'separate commit' while its reachability is unproven (e.g., a deepest drafter level with 1 node per request). It fires identically in both regimes so cross-regime attribution is safe, but it should be landed (or unreachability proven) BEFORE binding any CASE-1 'verify-function lossless' claim, since a latent deterministic mis-addressing would sit inside that bind.

BAG_TV_FLOOR=0.0593 is a BI-off (E5) constant reused as the budget lower bound inside the BI-on gate (fr13_corruption_gate.py:121-123, :413); partially shielded because native_self comes from the different-seed (N1,Nn) pair, but the CASE-1 bind should note the budget's cross-regime provenance and lean on the determinism compares + real_loss/accept/root-reject corroborations for the carrier call, not bag-TV alone.
